submission.notes: Block-3 FFN: overwrote 4 low-impact neurons (520,2347,2693,680) with two ReLU-gated pairs: (a) negated-adjective detector (LDA on FFN input, generalises to unseen negators) that flips the token's remaining sentiment component x1.5 along the residual sentiment direction; (b) negator-token detector that neutralises the negator's own valence. 6,148 weights changed; dev implicit 50%->98.6%, held-out novel phrasings 51%->89%, explicit/affirmative 100%, real guard unchanged.
